about: Requests a person really types about the small service in `fixture` (a route table, health/export/digest handlers, a scheduler). None names a skill. `expect` lists every skill that is a right first pick; [] means no skill of this plugin should load (ordinary work, or a question the model just answers). route.py records the first skill the agent opens, and the skill the plugin's route-hint hook suggested.

cases.prompt: The nightly digest stopped going out after yesterday's deploy and I have no idea why.
The export sometimes returns the wrong totals. Figure out what's going on.
Change scheduler.py to import the digest job directly instead of loading it by name from settings. Don't break the nightly run.
I want to turn this into an app where my team can log which customers they called this week. Where do we start?
We need a real job queue for the digest instead of cron. How should this be structured: Postgres queue or Redis?
Draw me a picture of how the pieces of this service connect.
I wrote the export handler but hitting it does nothing. Is it even hooked up?
Before this goes out: does the health check actually do what it should? Test it properly.
The health check takes eight seconds to answer under load. Make it fast.
We're about to expose the export endpoint to anonymous users on the internet. Can someone abuse it?
Be honest: is this codebase any good? What's the biggest problem?
Can you give me a second opinion on this code before I merge it?
The handlers folder feels like spaghetti. Is it, or is it just me?
What code in here is dead and safe to delete?
Ship this to production tonight.
I need to rename the email column to contact_email in the users table on the live database.
Upgrade this service to the newest Python version without breaking anything.
Get the export handler routed and working. Keep going on it overnight, I'm going to sleep.
Where were we? Catch me up on this project.
Why does the scheduler load digest by name from settings instead of importing it? Who decided that?
Walk me through how a request travels through this app. Don't change anything.
What features does this app actually have, and how do I reach each one?
Here's the plan: 1) route the export handler, 2) add a test for the digest, 3) add auth to export. File these as tracked issues.
Set this repo up so the engineering skills work well in it.
I've never seen this codebase before. Get me fully up to speed: what it has, how it's built, and why.
Add a header comment to export.py, and check your own work until it really passes.
I want to add an LLM agent that writes the nightly digest. How do I know if it's any good before I build it?
Our support agent passes sometimes and fails other times. Does it actually work?
My coding agent deleted handlers/health.py last night when I asked it to clean up imports. Why did it do that?
We're about to put our AI agent in front of real customers. What do we need first?
Fix the typo in health.py's docstring if there is one, otherwise add one that says 'Liveness probe.'
What does HTTP status 418 mean?
Rename the function check() in handlers/health.py to ping() and update its caller.
